heading_path: 57  Registration may be opposed on same grounds as for rejection
text: The registration of a trade mark may be opposed on any of the grounds on which an application for the registration of a trade mark may be rejected under this Act, except the ground that the trade mark cannot be represented graphically. Note: For this Act see section 6.
